details:
Manual synchronization stops updating synced variables on non-owner clients with certain field configurations, despite the owner reporting successful serialization.

In the failing cases, the non-owner receives OnDeserialization, but the synced fields remain at their initial values.

ENVIRONMENT

────────────────────────

Unity: 2022.3.22f1

VRChat Worlds SDK: 3.10.4

Tested with actual VRChat clients in the same instance

STEPS TO REPRODUCE

────────────────────────

1. Attach the provided Float20SyncProbe and Double20SyncProbe scripts to separate GameObjects.

2. Assign a separate TMP text display to each script.

3. Upload the world and join the same instance with two players.

4. The owner assigns new values and calls RequestSerialization() every 10 seconds.

5. Compare the owner's values with the non-owner's values on the displays and in the logs.

Both scripts use Manual synchronization. Only the owner writes the synced fields. Neither script uses FieldChangeCallback or calls Networking.SetOwner.

Despite their filenames, the attached scripts currently contain:

- Float20SyncProbe: 27 synced floats.

- Double20SyncProbe: 14 synced doubles and 1 synced int.

EXPECTED RESULT

────────────────────────

The non-owner's synced fields should update to match the owner's serialized values.

ACTUAL RESULT

────────────────────────

With the failing configurations, the non-owner's fields remain at their initial values.

Reducing the number of synced fields restores normal synchronization.

TEST RESULTS

────────────────────────

All configurations below were tested without FieldChangeCallback.

2 doubles          : Worked

2 floats           : Worked

13 doubles         : Worked

26 floats          : Worked

14 doubles         : Worked

27 floats          : Failed

14 doubles + 1 int : Failed

20 doubles         : Failed

Earlier tests also reproduced the issue with 20 doubles using FieldChangeCallback, while 20 floats worked.

Removing FieldChangeCallback did not resolve the double20 failure.

The results suggest that the amount or layout of synced data may be involved, but the exact cause is unknown.

POSSIBLY RELATED REPORTS

────────────────────────

1. A single UdonSharpBehavior with VRC Enable Persistence cannot store more than 108 bytes of the same variable type

https://feedback.vrchat.com/persistence/p/a-single-udonsharpbehavior-with-vrc-enable-persistence-cannot-store-more-than-10

2. PlayerObject Persistence Fails to Respect Sync Mode

https://feedback.vrchat.com/persistence/p/playerobject-persistence-fails-to-respect-sync-mode

Those reports concern Persistence restoration. This issue occurs during ordinary owner-to-non-owner synchronization within the same instance.

REPRODUCTION MATERIALS

────────────────────────

The attached scripts reproduce the issue independently and display each client's local synced values, receive count, consistency check, and serialization result.
title: Manual Udon sync fails despite successful serialization
